messages:
maya: Quick check — can we move ARB this week to Wed 10:00am PT? We have a pile of RFCs that would be useful to triage before EOD Friday.
jonathan: Wed 10 works for me, prefer we keep it 45m max.
samir: I can facilitate this week if needed. 30–45m ok.
rachel: Heads up I have a customer sync at 10. Would 11 work instead? otherwise I might need to hop in late.
maya: 11 would push into EMEA overlap. Proposal: keep Wed 10, samir facilitates, compact agenda:

```agenda
1) RFC triage (15m) — prioritize short TL;DRs
2) Design review: cache-routing proposal (15m)
3) Ops checkpoint: rollout canary + infra alert runbook (10m)
``` 

Anyone object or want to swap facilitator? :thumbsup: if ok.
jonathan: +1 to compact agenda. Samir confirm you can own pre-reads? I'll do quick notes on the cache PR.
samir: Confirmed. I'll assemble RFC links + 2-line TL;DRs tonight and add a 'decision' column in the agenda doc. Also suggest we trial a 4-week facilitator rotation and keep a shared signup sheet.
maya: Perfect. Samir, could you also add a short bullet on quantization guidance for Private deployments? It's come up twice this sprint.
samir: Added that bullet. Also adding a sticky note to remind reviewers to state rollback criteria for design approvals.
rachel: I can take week 2 of the rotation if someone wants a hand with co-facilitation.
jonathan: I'll take week 4. 
maya: pinging @infra-bot to update calendar and post the agenda link.
infra-bot: calendar updated — ARB Wed 10:00am PT — Samir (facilitator). Event: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1832156789 — agenda doc: https://docs.redwood.com/arb/agenda
maya: Thanks! I'll jump on triage prep tomorrow morning. :coffee:
